map.瓦楞纸箱抗压（BCT）按 McKee（马基）经验式估算：: Corrugated box compression (BCT) is estimated with the McKee empirical formula:
map.，其中 ECT 为纸板边压强度（N/150mm），T 为纸板厚度（mm），Z 为: , where ECT is the board edge crush strength (N/150mm), T is the board thickness (mm), and Z is the box perimeter (mm). ECT is obtained by summing the ring crush strength Rct of each paper layer (including the flute take-up factor and the medium contribution).
map.瓦楞类型影响：A 楞 ECT 高、E 楞平整；BCT 还随堆码高度、温湿度下降。: Flute type matters: A flute gives a high ECT while E flute is flat; BCT also drops as stacking height, temperature and humidity increase.
map.安全系数通常取 3–5（仓储/运输/湿度条件越差越大）。: The safety factor is usually taken as 3-5 (the worse the storage/transport/humidity conditions, the larger it is).
map.结果仅供参考，正式包装设计以 GB/T 6543 与实测抗压为准。: Results are for reference only; formal packaging design should follow GB/T 6543 and measured compression strength.
map.💡 ECT ≈ (面纸RCT + 里纸RCT + 芯纸RCT × 瓦楞率) ×: 💡 ECT ≈ (liner RCT + inner liner RCT + medium RCT × flute take-up) × conversion factor; BCT = 5.87 × ECT × √(perimeter × thickness); safe load = BCT ÷ SF; max stacking layers = floor(safe load ÷ load per layer) + 1.

map.McKee 公式适用于常规运输瓦楞纸箱，受温湿度、印刷开槽影响: The McKee formula applies to conventional transport corrugated boxes and is affected by temperature, humidity, printing and slotting

map.运输包装设计中，由瓦楞纸板边压(ECT)估算箱体抗压(BCT)，定堆码层数。: In transport packaging design, the box body compression (BCT) is estimated from the corrugated board edge crush (ECT) to set the number of stacking layers.
map.纸箱选型时，按货物重量与安全系数反推所需 ECT 与楞型。: When selecting a box, back-calculate the required ECT and flute type from the goods weight and the safety factor.
map.仓储规划中，由 BCT 与安全系数核算单层承重与最大堆高。: In warehouse planning, use BCT and the safety factor to account for the load per layer and the maximum stacking height.

map.这是 McKee 经验公式的常用形式，适用于规则开槽箱(RSC)、瓦楞方向正确的: This is a common form of the McKee empirical formula, applicable to regular slotted containers (RSC) with the ECT entered for the correct flute orientation. ECT can be estimated from the liner/medium ring crush strengths and the flute take-up factor (ECT≈(liner+liner+medium×takeup)×efficiency), or it can be measured and entered directly.
map.一般运输仓储取 3–5，潮湿/长周期/自动堆码取高值。它综合温湿度、堆码时间、振: For general transport and storage take 3-5, and take a higher value for damp, long-cycle or automatic stacking conditions. It combines temperature and humidity, stacking time, vibration and handling factors; too small a safety factor risks collapse, too large wastes material and raises cost.

ECT is estimated from the ring crush strength of the liner, inner liner and medium together with the flute type, then BCT is computed with the McKee formula, and the maximum safe stacking layers and stacking height are given by combining the safety factor.
